title: pergularia clausa
intro: Pergularia clausa, commonly known as Satavar, is a flowering plant species native to the Indian subcontinent and the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders, fever, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits such as regulating the menstrual cycle and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pergularia clausa include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which help to relieve menstrual cramps, fever, and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
